scenes.narration: This is Ima Bootcamper's Senzing Agentic AI Bootcamp, November 9, 2026.
Ima chose Core: eleven modules, in Python.
First, the idea: records about one person become one entity.

scenes.highlight: One customer view across CRM, Billing and Support
scenes.narration: Then Ima's problem. The same customers were scattered across a CRM, a billing system and support tickets, spelled differently, with gaps, and nobody could say how many customers there really were. The goal: one clean view of each customer.

scenes.heading: Truth Set: match keys
scenes.narration: A practice run on the Truth Set showed resolution at work.

scenes.heading: Truth Set: cross-source overlap
scenes.narration: And how its three sources overlapped.

scenes.title: Records per source
scenes.narration: Then Ima's own data: ten thousand deliberately messy records, four thousand in CRM, four thousand in Billing and two thousand support tickets.
Each field was mapped to Senzing.
Ten thousand records loaded into 6,671 entities.
Here is what Senzing found. Records from all three systems came together as the customers they really are.

scenes.title: What Senzing found
scenes.narration: Over two thousand customers span two or more systems, 451 appear in all three, and 737 pairs wait for review.

scenes.heading: Your match keys
scenes.narration: Name, address and phone drove the merges.

scenes.heading: Your systems, side by side
scenes.narration: Every overlap is in Ima's own results app.

scenes.text: Resolved: Ima Bootcamper, Senzing Bootcamp graduate.
scenes.narration: Resolved: Ima Bootcamper, Senzing Bootcamp graduate.
